say:2:1430405401:1.text: With the dragon gone, there will be no more dragon eggs here—so no more echorites, either.
say:2:1430405401:1.source_cn: 龙飞走了，这里不会再有龙蛋，自然也就不会再有深岩晶。
say:2:1430405401:1.male: With the dragon gone, there will be no more dragon eggs here—so no more echorites, either.
say:2:1430405401:1.female: With the dragon gone, there will be no more dragon eggs here—so no more echorites, either.

say:3:1430405402:1.text: Without echorites, what are we supposed to do in the future?
say:3:1430405402:1.source_cn: 没有深岩晶，我们之后该怎么办？

say:4:1430405403:1.text: No idea... I doubt anyone in the village knows what the future holds for us.
say:4:1430405403:1.source_cn: 我不知道……我想，就连村子里也没有矮人知道。
